product_launches.description: Thyme Care expanded availability of its virtual survivorship program, Next Chapter Care, offering nurse-led longitudinal post-treatment oncology support to more than 15,000 eligible members across the U.S.

press_references.value: Thyme Care Launches Integrated Social Support Model, Bringing Proactive Oncology Social Work to 8 Million Americans Upon Diagnosis

product_launches.description: Thyme Care publicly launched its Integrated Social Support model, a tech-enabled oncology navigation program that makes licensed social workers the first point of contact to address cancer patients' psychosocial, financial, and practical needs.

overview_description.description: Thyme Care provides value-based oncology management services designed to coordinate care for individuals diagnosed with cancer. The company pairs individuals with dedicated support teams composed of nurses and care partners who assist with appointment scheduling, symptom tracking, transportation logistics, and financial resources. Its platform integrates clinical analytics and navigation software directly into health plan systems and oncology practice workflows to identify patient needs early. By offering round-the-clock clinical guidance and resource coordination, the organization works alongside health plans, risk-bearing entities, and medical providers to improve health outcomes and reduce unnecessary medical expenditures.

identifier.value: Oncology Care Navigation and Care Coordination

product.name: Oncology Care Navigation and Care Coordination
product.description: A cancer care management service that provides personalized navigation, symptom support, care coordination, and assistance with clinical and non-clinical barriers throughout the cancer journey.

product.name: 24/7 Virtual Clinical and Supportive Care
product.description: Round-the-clock virtual access to oncology nurses, providers, and resource specialists for non-emergency symptom management, medication questions, care coordination, and support between appointments.

product.name: Enhanced Supportive Care
product.description: Whole-person supportive care for people with cancer that addresses symptoms, serious illness, emotional needs, advance care planning, and referrals to palliative care or hospice.

product.name: Thyme Box
product.description: A care management platform that gives Thyme Care teams member profiles, risk information, symptom data, and engagement tools for coordinated oncology support.

product.name: Thyme Care Connect
product.description: A web-based member application that provides self-service cancer education, symptom assessments, care resources, and access to Thyme Care support.

product.name: Patient Monitoring and Proactive Outreach
product.description: A monitoring service that uses patient-reported outcomes, treatment-specific surveys, and risk information to identify symptoms or needs and prompt timely care-team intervention.
